title: The Delhi High Court Act, 1966
full_text: The Delhi High Court Act, 1966 null Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 196626 Act Number: 26 Enactment Date: 1966-09-05 Act Year: 1966 Short Title: The Delhi High Court Act, 1966 Long Title: An Act to provide for the constitution of a High Court for the Union territory of Delhi, for the extension of the jurisdiction of that High Court to the Union territory of Himachal Pradesh and for matters connected therewith. Department: Law, Justice and Legislative Affairs Department Enforcement Date: 01-05-1967 Type: CENTRAL ACT (Ministry of Law and Justice, Department of Justice) Location: Delhi Notification: 1st May, 1967, vide notification No. G.S.R. 508 (E), dated 11th April, 1967, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3 (i).
